title: Crypto-Cash Back: Linking Your Crypto Wallet to Your Account
summary: This document explains how to link a crypto wallet to your account for “Crypto-Cash Back” redemptions, including direct wallet integration (Settings > Crypto Wallets > Add Wallet, authenticate/approve, set as default for redemptions, complete verification/signing if prompted) and manual address setup (Rewards > Redeem to Crypto > Manual Address, paste public address and memo/tag, verify network/address format, save/label).
